items.t: Front air springs leak and the car sags
items.job: Replace both front air struts
items.note: Owners report aftermarket air struts near $150 each versus about $350 or more each from a dealer. Replace the air drier at the same time.

items.t: Air suspension compressor wears out
items.job: Convert all four corners to coil springs (replaces air springs and compressor)
items.note: Fixing the leaks and replacing only the compressor can cost less if the air springs are still good.

items.t: Front height sensor link breaks
items.job: Air suspension diagnosis and height sensor link check
items.note: RepairPal estimates $61–$90 for the diagnosis. A replacement sensor or link costs extra, but much less than air springs.

items.t: Shudder at highway speed from torque converter
items.job: Complete transmission fluid exchange including the torque converter
items.note: If the shudder returns after fresh fluid, the torque converter may need replacing, which costs much more.

items.t: Harsh or banging 1-2 shift
items.job: Replace 1-2 accumulator piston and spring (Ford bulletin 97-11-11)
items.note: Ford's bulletin allows 1.3 hours and the transmission stays in the car. Owners report about $150 in parts when solenoids are replaced too.

items.t: Car slips into neutral while driving
items.job: Replace manual lever position (transmission range) sensor
items.note: YourMechanic estimates about $265–$312 for 1996–1998.

items.t: Vibration or drone above 60 mph
items.job: Replace driveshaft (after tire balancing fails to fix it)
items.note: Start with tire balancing and a driveshaft runout check, which cost far less. YourMechanic estimates about $2,340–$2,390 for a new driveshaft.

items.t: HID low beam goes dark
items.job: Replace HID headlamp bulb, ballast or housing
items.note: A complete HID headlamp housing from a dealer was about $600 per side; used parts cost less.

items.t: Headlight lenses cloud or collect moisture
items.job: Replace headlight assembly
items.note: Parts range from a used HID headlight (about $249) to about $600 per side from a dealer. Restoring cloudy lenses costs much less.

items.t: Outside door handle snaps
items.job: Replace and paint outside door handle
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $180 total; one paid $90 for the part plus about 4 hours of labor.

items.t: Heater core leaks
items.job: Replace heater core (dashboard removal)
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $1,550 to $2,030 because the dash has to come apart.

items.t: Cruise control switch can overheat and catch fire (recall)
items.job: Install fused wiring harness for speed control deactivation switch
items.note: Free at a Lincoln dealer if not already done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Long crank or stall on cold starts
items.job: Replace idle air control valve
items.note: YourMechanic estimates about $283–$291 for 1996–1998. Cleaning the valve may be enough.

items.t: Anti-theft system blocks starting
items.job: Anti-theft system diagnosis
items.note: RepairPal estimates $61–$90 for the diagnosis. A new key or programming costs extra.

items.t: Rattle from cam chain tensioners at start-up
items.job: Replace secondary timing chain tensioners
items.note: Owners cite about $1,200 for Ford's fix. A brief rattle that fades is often left alone.

items.t: Misfire from ignition coil boots or worn plugs
items.job: Replace spark plugs and faulty coil boots or coils

items.t: Check engine light from camshaft sensor wiring
items.job: Repair cam sensor connector wiring or replace camshaft position sensor

items.t: Hesitation from a dirty mass airflow sensor
items.job: Replace mass airflow sensor
items.note: RepairPal estimates $166–$232 for 1996–1998. Cleaning the sensor first costs much less.

items.t: Steering wheel shakes when braking
items.job: Replace brake rotors and pads (one axle)
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $265 to $320 for pads alone; YourMechanic estimates about $700 for rear rotors on a 1998.

items.t: Front ball joint can wear and separate
items.job: Replace front control arm with ball joint
items.note: YourMechanic estimates about $520 to $720 for one front upper control arm.

items.t: Blower motor chirps or squeaks
items.job: Replace blower motor

items.t: Auto-dimming mirror turns yellow or leaks
items.job: Replace outside mirror glass
items.note: A dealer auto-dimming glass is about $200; a plain glass insert cut to fit costs less.

items.t: Rear sway bar cracks from inside rust
items.job: Replace rear sway bar
items.note: The Ford bar (F5LY-5A772-A) is about $92–$128. RepairPal estimates $192–$351 if the end links are replaced too.
